captions.detailed: A light grey surveillance blimp featuring a long, aerodynamic envelope and a dark grey sensor gondola mounted on its underside. Twin engine nacelles with black propellers are attached to the sides of the gondola, and a tail assembly with vertical and horizontal control surfaces is positioned at the rear of the envelope. The propellers spin continuously on their local axes, while the rudder and elevators rotate on their respective hinges to provide directional control.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a surveillance blimp with a streamlined light grey envelope, a dark grey underside gondola, side-mounted engine nacelles with spinning propellers, and a rear tail assembly with adjustable rudders and elevators.
captions.factory: Construct the main envelope by revolving a custom spline or profile curve around its longitudinal axis. Model the gondola using combined box and cylinder primitives, and attach side-mounted engine nacelles with local coordinate systems for the propellers. Create the tail fins as flat extruded plates, and define revolute joints for the rudder and elevators, and continuous joints for the propellers.
